package.title: 地下世界（希芙拉河/安瑟尔河/诺克隆/深根底层/腐败湖/蒙格温王朝）

record.label: 希芙拉河井底
record.description: 希芙拉河井下降到底部后激活的赐福。

record.label: 希芙拉河远端电梯
record.description: 从井底区域继续前进后使用的电梯；这是跨楼层连接节点。

record.label: 希芙拉河岸
record.description: 希芙拉河主河道的赐福；从井底通过远端电梯抵达。

record.label: Hallowhorn Grounds (Siofra River)
record.description: Southern Hallowhorn Grounds beside the lower Siofra River; kept separate from Nokron's northern Hallowhorn Grounds.

record.label: Ancestor Spirit
record.description: Lower Siofra Ancestor Spirit gate; all eight braziers must be lit before touching the horned remains.

record.label: Ancestor Spirit (post-boss return)
record.description: Explicit post-Ancestor-Spirit state, kept separate from the ordinary Siofra River Bank route.

record.label: Below the Well
record.floor: Northern Siofra / Deep Well lift approach
record.description: Northern Siofra grace at the lower end of the lift to the Deep Siofra Well; it is not the Caelid surface grace.

record.label: Deep Siofra Well lift
record.description: Northern Siofra two-Stonesword-Key lift; its upper and lower endpoints belong to different world planes.

record.label: Hidden Arcane Waygate (Siofra)
record.description: Worshippers' Woods south-side sending gate on a fallen pillar; it is the portal route to the upper Siofra waterfall area.

record.label: Dragonkin Soldier (Siofra River)
record.description: Optional Siofra Dragonkin Soldier boss reached through the hidden sending gate; distinct from Dragonkin Soldier of Nokstella in Ainsel River.

record.label: Dragonkin Soldier (Siofra post-boss state)
record.description: Boss-cleared state for the isolated upper Siofra plateau; no nonexistent Site of Grace or reverse Waygate is fabricated. After the boss condition is met, the only modeled exit is map fast travel to the entry-grace representative.

record.label: 安瑟尔河主流
record.description: 蕾娜魔法塔传送门的目标赐福。

record.label: 诺克隆，永恒之城
record.description: 星陨坑下降后的诺克隆入口赐福。

record.label: Ainsel River Well Depths
record.description: Southern Ainsel entrance grace reached by the Liurnia well; this branch cannot continue to Nokstella or Lake of Rot.

record.label: Ainsel River Well lift
record.description: The vertical lift between eastern Liurnia and Ainsel River Well Depths; separate from Renna's Rise's quest waygate.

record.label: Deeproot to Ainsel coffin
record.floor: The Nameless Eternal City western waterfall
record.description: The second Deeproot coffin at the western waterfall edge; distinct from the Great Waterfall Basin coffin that enters Deeproot.

record.label: Ainsel River Sluice Gate
record.description: Grace after the southern well-depth tunnels and before the lift into the Uhl Palace Ruins.

record.label: Uhl Palace Ruins (upper section)
record.floor: Uhl Palace Ruins upper lift landing
record.description: Upper Uhl Palace Ruins section at the Sluice Gate lift landing. The negative height in the sidecar is preserved as raw game XYZ; it is not used as the abstract layout y coordinate.

record.label: Uhl Palace Ruins (lower section)
record.floor: Uhl Palace Ruins lower river route
record.description: Lower Uhl Palace Ruins section on the river route before Ainsel River Downstream; it is kept separate from the upper lift landing.

record.label: Ainsel River Downstream
record.description: Downstream grace after the Sluice Gate/Uhl Palace route, immediately before the Dragonkin Soldier arena.

record.label: Dragonkin Soldier of Nokstella
record.description: Optional southern Ainsel boss; its arena has no onward route to the northern Ranni branch.

record.label: Dragonkin Soldier of Nokstella (post-boss grace)
record.description: Post-Dragonkin grace in the southern branch; it is an endpoint rather than a hidden connection to Lake of Rot.

record.label: Baleful Shadow
record.description: Ranni quest invader gate between Nokstella Waterfall Basin and the Lake of Rot lift.

record.label: Mimic Tear
record.description: Mandatory early Nokron boss gate before the Ancestral Woods grace.

record.label: Mimic Tear
record.description: Post-Mimic grace activated immediately after the boss arena, before the bridge to Ancestral Woods.

record.label: Night's Sacred Ground
record.description: Nokron quest branch grace near the Fingerslayer Blade and the return portal to Ancestral Woods.

record.label: Hallowhorn Grounds (North)
record.description: Northern Hallowhorn Grounds on Nokron's upper Siofra level, reached from Ancestral Woods; kept separate from the lower Siofra Hallowhorn Grounds.

record.label: Regal Ancestor Spirit
record.description: Optional six-flame/Hallowhorn Grounds boss branch from Ancestral Woods.

record.label: Regal Ancestor Spirit (post-boss return)
record.description: Explicit post-Regal-Ancestor state; the teleport returns the player to the Nokron woods before the Aqueduct branch.

record.label: Great Waterfall Basin
record.description: Post-Valiant-Gargoyles grace beside the waterfall and coffin to Deeproot Depths.

record.label: Great Waterfall Crest
record.description: First grace after the Aqueduct coffin, southwest of the main Deeproot root network.

record.label: The Nameless Eternal City
record.description: Lower root-city landmark between the coffin arrival and the upward Across the Roots route.

record.label: Across the Roots
record.description: Upper-root grace before Fia's Champions and the Prince of Death's Throne.

record.label: Root-Facing Cliffs
record.description: Optional/hidden western Deeproot route associated with the Frenzied Flame descent; kept separate from the Fia route.

record.label: Fia's Champions
record.description: Fia quest boss group at the upper end of the Deeproot root route.

record.label: Lichdragon Fortissax
record.description: Optional Fia quest dream boss; the entry is gated by the Cursemark and Fia's post-Champions state.

record.label: Lichdragon Fortissax (post-boss state)
record.description: Post-dream-boss return state; kept separate from the Prince of Death's Throne grace.

record.label: Nokstella, Eternal City
record.description: Formal route node for the Nokstella city section; the catalog contains the underlying grace entry.

record.label: Nokstella Waterfall Basin
record.description: Vertical transition node below Nokstella, before the descent to Lake of Rot.

record.label: Lake of Rot Shoreside
record.description: Entry node for the rot lake crossing; route risk is represented on the outgoing edge.

record.label: Grand Cloister
record.description: Cloister node containing the coffin transition to the Astel encounter.

record.label: Astel, Naturalborn of the Void
record.description: Boss gate reached by the Grand Cloister coffin; the exit is state-gated.

record.label: Astel, Naturalborn of the Void
record.description: Independent post-boss grace in Astel's arena; it is separate from the boss fog gate and precedes the Ring-gated lift to Moonlight Altar.

record.label: Siofra Aqueduct / Valiant Gargoyles
record.description: Aqueduct boss gate before the coffin transfer to Deeproot Depths. The online XYZ is the exact-name Valiant Gargoyle boss-position record, not a local fog-wall geometry survey.

record.label: Deeproot coffin
record.description: One-way coffin transition after the Valiant Gargoyles gate.

record.label: Deeproot Depths
record.description: Arrival node for the Deeproot coffin route.

record.label: Prince of Death's Throne
record.description: Upper-root route destination in Deeproot Depths.

record.label: Palace Approach Ledge-Road
record.description: The sending-gate arrival side of Mohgwyn Palace.

record.label: Dynasty Mausoleum Entrance
record.description: Common arrival grace for the Pureblood Medal route and intermediate Palace route.

record.label: Dynasty Mausoleum Midpoint
record.description: Interior midpoint before the Mohg elevator and boss gate.

record.label: Mohg, Lord of Blood
record.description: Mohg boss gate reached from the midpoint elevator.

record.label: Cocoon of the Empyrean
record.description: Post-Mohg grace and Shadow of the Erdtree access landmark.

record.label: Siofra Well descent lift
record.description: Vertical plane transition between the Mistwood surface and lower Siofra.

record.label: Worshippers' Woods
record.description: Siofra River branch grace retained separately from Nokron's upper city.

record.label: Ancestral Woods
record.description: Upper Nokron route node before the Aqueduct-Facing Cliffs.

record.mode: 地下遗迹步行
record.note: 从井底赐福向希芙拉河远端电梯前进；目录资料不提供原始坐标。

record.mode: 远端电梯↑
record.note: 电梯把玩家从井底路线带到希芙拉河主河道赐福；不生成反向边。

record.mode: Ainsel River Well descent
record.note: The well elevator reaches the Ainsel River Well Depths grace at the start of the southern branch.

record.mode: Ainsel River return lift
record.note: The same well elevator is modeled as bidirectional for return travel to Liurnia.

record.mode: Ainsel Well Depths to Sluice Gate
record.note: The southern Ainsel well tunnels lead to the Sluice Gate grace; this branch is separate from the Renna's Rise Ainsel Main entry.

record.mode: Ainsel Sluice Gate lift to upper Uhl Palace Ruins
record.note: Take the nearby elevator from the Sluice Gate to the upper Uhl Palace Ruins landing; the vertical transition is explicit.

record.mode: Upper Uhl Palace Ruins return to Sluice Gate
record.note: Use the same lift to return from the upper ruins section to the Sluice Gate grace.

record.mode: Upper Uhl Palace Ruins to lower river section
record.note: Cross the ruin platforms and descend through the Clayman-occupied route to the lower river section.

record.mode: Lower Uhl Palace Ruins return to upper section
record.note: Climb back through the same ruin platforms to the upper lift landing.

record.mode: Lower Uhl Palace Ruins to Ainsel River Downstream
record.note: Follow the river route southwest from the lower ruins to the Downstream grace.

record.mode: Ainsel River Downstream return to lower Uhl Palace Ruins
record.note: Follow the river upstream from Downstream back into the lower Uhl Palace Ruins section.

record.mode: Ainsel Downstream to Dragonkin Soldier
record.note: The downstream tunnel opens into the southern throne cavern; the waterfall beyond is not traversable to the northern Ainsel branch.

record.mode: Dragonkin Soldier completion
record.note: The southern Ainsel post-boss grace is an endpoint; online walkthroughs explicitly state this branch cannot continue through the waterfall.

record.mode: underground passage
record.note: Ainsel River Main continues into the Nokstella city section; no surface shortcut is implied.

record.mode: elevator descent
record.note: The basin is a lower floor of the Nokstella route, not a nearby surface marker.

record.mode: elevator descent
record.note: Conservative Ranni-state gate for the descent after the Baleful Shadow section.

record.mode: Baleful Shadow completion to Lake of Rot
record.note: After the Ranni quest invader, the lift opens toward the Lake of Rot; the Baleful Shadow is no longer bypassed by a direct grace-to-grace edge.

record.mode: rot lake crossing
record.note: Represents the hazardous crossing and route landmarks; it is not an Euclidean straight-line edge.

record.mode: coffin transfer
record.note: The coffin is modeled as a one-way plane transition into the Astel encounter area.

record.mode: Astel completion to arena grace
record.note: The post-boss Site of Grace is modeled as a separate standable node in the arena rather than being hidden inside the boss edge.

record.mode: coffin transfer
record.note: The Aqueduct boss gate must be cleared before the coffin transition is considered reachable.

record.mode: Great Waterfall Basin coffin
record.note: The coffin is a one-way transfer from the post-Gargoyles waterfall grace to Deeproot Depths.

record.mode: coffin arrival
record.note: The arrival remains on the underground Deeproot layer.

record.mode: root traverse
record.note: Represents the root-and-ledge route to the upper Deeproot landmark.

record.mode: blood lake and mausoleum approach
record.note: The portal arrival and mausoleum entrance are distinct nodes.

record.mode: mausoleum interior
record.note: Interior route toward the midpoint elevator.

record.mode: mausoleum elevator and boss approach
record.note: The elevator is retained as a transition type rather than collapsed into a flat walk edge.

record.mode: Mohg completion
record.note: Post-boss Cocoon grace state.

record.mode: Siofra Well descent
record.note: Surface-to-underground plane transition.

record.mode: Siofra upper bank branch
record.note: Separate lower-Siofra branch; no automatic cross-edge to upper Nokron is assumed.

record.mode: Siofra River Bank to southern Hallowhorn Grounds
record.note: The southern Hallowhorn Grounds is the lower Siofra branch southeast of Siofra River Bank; it is not the Regal Ancestor branch in Nokron.

record.mode: Southern Hallowhorn Grounds brazier puzzle
record.note: The lower Siofra boss appears only after all eight braziers are lit and the horned remains are activated.

record.mode: Ancestor Spirit completion
record.note: Boss completion is represented as a separate state node so the route planner can distinguish the cleared arena from the approach.

record.mode: Siofra River Bank to Below the Well
record.note: Follow the northern/eastern cliff route past the bridge and spirit-spring branch to the Below the Well grace.

record.mode: Below the Well lift approach
record.note: The northern lift stands beside Below the Well; the two-key seal is modeled on the lift activation edges.

record.mode: Worshippers' Woods to Below the Well
record.note: The route from Worshippers' Woods continues north along the cliff and joins the Below the Well approach; this is an alternate branch from the direct River Bank route.

record.mode: Deep Siofra Well descent lift
record.note: Return from the lift shaft to the Below the Well grace after unlocking the two-key seal.

record.mode: Worshippers' Woods to fallen-pillar waygate
record.note: Backtrack south from Worshippers' Woods to the collapsed pillar; the portal is not the northern Deep Well lift.

record.mode: Siofra upper waterfall waygate
record.note: The fallen-pillar portal sends the player to the upper waterfall plateau immediately before the Siofra Dragonkin Soldier route.

record.mode: Siofra Dragonkin Soldier completion
record.note: The boss reward/cleared state is explicit, while no artificial post-boss grace is added because the online sources identify no such grace here.

record.mode: Nokron upper route
record.note: Upper-city route after the separate Starfall Crater entrance edge.

record.mode: Nokron aqueduct approach
record.note: Keeps the aqueduct approach as its own named floor node.

record.mode: Mimic Tear completion
record.note: The post-Mimic grace is a separate boss completion state before the bridge to Ancestral Woods.

record.mode: Mimic Tear bridge to Ancestral Woods
record.note: The bridge and Torrent-enabled woods route begins after the Mimic gate; Ancestral Woods is not placed directly at the crater entrance.

record.mode: Ancestral Woods to Night's Sacred Ground
record.note: The lower rooftops and Silver Tear structures lead to the Night's Sacred Ground grace and Fingerslayer Blade route.

record.mode: Ancestral Woods to northern Hallowhorn Grounds
record.note: After the Mimic Tear branch, follow Nokron's upper woods route to the separate northern Hallowhorn Grounds landmark.

record.mode: Northern Hallowhorn Grounds brazier puzzle
record.note: The Regal Ancestor Spirit encounter activates only after all six northern Hallowhorn braziers are lit and the horned remains are touched.

record.mode: Regal Ancestor Spirit completion
record.note: The Hollowhorn teleport returns to Nokron after the optional boss; it is modeled separately from the ordinary woods route.

record.mode: Night's Sacred Ground to Aqueduct-Facing Cliffs
record.note: The northeast cliff and jellyfish descent reaches the Aqueduct-facing grace; the Siofra Aqueduct is an independent lower layer.

record.mode: Siofra Aqueduct approach
record.note: Aqueduct-facing grace to the Valiant Gargoyles gate.

record.mode: Great Waterfall Crest root crossing
record.note: Cross the lower roots from the coffin arrival grace into the main Deeproot Depths area.

record.mode: Deeproot Depths to Nameless Eternal City
record.note: The root-city route crosses the central Deeproot structures before rising toward Across the Roots.

record.mode: Nameless Eternal City root ascent
record.note: Climb the large roots to the upper eastern cliff and Across the Roots grace.

record.mode: Nameless Eternal City to Ainsel coffin
record.note: The western waterfall edge near The Nameless Eternal City contains a second coffin; it is separate from the Great Waterfall Basin entry coffin.

record.mode: Deeproot coffin to Ainsel River Main
record.note: Resting in the Deeproot coffin sends the player to the northern Ainsel River Main arrival; this is a one-way plane transition.

record.mode: Deeproot hidden western route
record.note: Optional western/hidden branch associated with the Frenzied Flame route; it is not merged into Fia's eastern root ascent.

record.mode: Across the Roots to Fia's Champions
record.note: The upper battlefield and sending gate lead to Fia's Champions; the Prince of Death's Throne grace is post-boss state.

record.mode: Fia's Champions completion
record.note: The Prince of Death's Throne grace becomes the post-Champions Fia state.

record.mode: Fia's Deathbed Dream entry
record.note: Fia's sleep and the Cursemark open the Deathbed Dream; this is a plane transition into Fortissax's arena.

record.mode: Lichdragon Fortissax completion
record.note: Post-Dream-boss state returns to the Deeproot/Fia quest context.

record.mode: Ainsel Sluice Gate return to Well Depths
record.note: Return through the southern Ainsel tunnels to the Well Depths grace.

record.mode: Ainsel Downstream lift return to Sluice Gate
record.note: Ride the Ainsel lift back from the downstream route to the Sluice Gate.

record.mode: Nokstella return to Ainsel River Main
record.note: Return through the Ainsel River Main passage from the Nokstella city section.

record.mode: Nokstella Waterfall Basin lift return
record.note: Ride the Nokstella elevator back to the Eternal City level.

record.mode: Grand Cloister return across Lake of Rot
record.note: Retrace the rot-lake platforms and shoreline route to the Lake of Rot grace.

record.mode: Siofra Well Depths return to descent lift
record.note: Return through the well shaft to the lift platform.

record.mode: Worshippers' Woods return to Siofra River Bank
record.note: Return south along the Siofra underground branch to the River Bank grace.

record.mode: Southern Hallowhorn Grounds return to Siofra River Bank
record.note: Return from the southern Hallowhorn branch to Siofra River Bank.

record.mode: Below the Well return to Siofra River Bank
record.note: Return along the northern/eastern cliff route to the main River Bank grace.

record.mode: Below the Well return to Worshippers' Woods
record.note: Use the alternate northern cliff branch back toward Worshippers' Woods.

record.mode: Deeproot Depths return to Great Waterfall Crest
record.note: Return along the lower root and water route to the Great Waterfall Crest arrival side.

record.mode: Nameless Eternal City return to Deeproot Depths
record.note: Return across the root and ruin route from the Nameless Eternal City to the lower Deeproot grace.

record.mode: Dynasty Mausoleum Entrance return to Palace Approach
record.note: Leave the mausoleum approach through the blood-lake path and return to Palace Approach Ledge-Road.

record.mode: Dynasty Mausoleum Midpoint return to Entrance
record.note: Descend the mausoleum tunnel and return to the Entrance grace.

record.mode: Cocoon of the Empyrean return to Mausoleum Midpoint
record.note: After Mohg, Lord of Blood is defeated, leave the cocoon chamber through the cleared mausoleum route to the Midpoint grace.

record.mode: Root-Facing Cliffs return to Deeproot Depths
record.note: Retrace the western hidden-root branch back to the Deeproot Depths hub grace.

record.mode: Prince of Death's Throne return to Across the Roots
record.note: Leave Fia's throne area through the cleared Champions route and return to the upper root crossing.

record.mode: Fortissax post-boss return to Prince of Death's Throne
record.note: The Deathbed Dream returns the player beside Fia at the Prince of Death's Throne after Fortissax is defeated.

record.mode: Ancestor Spirit post-boss return to Hallowhorn Grounds
record.note: Leave the cleared southern Hallowhorn boss area and return to the Siofra Hallowhorn Grounds landmark.

record.mode: Regal Ancestor post-boss return to northern Hallowhorn Grounds
record.note: The cleared optional boss state returns to the northern Hallowhorn Grounds landmark before the normal woods route.

record.mode: Northern Hallowhorn Grounds return to Ancestral Woods
record.note: Retrace the upper Siofra route from the northern Hallowhorn Grounds to Ancestral Woods; this is not a direct teleport shortcut.

record.mode: Dragonkin Soldier post-boss return to Ainsel Downstream
record.note: Leave the cleared throne cavern and retrace the Ainsel downstream route; the Sluice Gate lift remains the next return layer.

record.mode: Siofra upper plateau map fast-travel exit
record.note: The sending gate is an entry transition, not a modeled reverse portal. After defeating the boss and leaving combat, use the map fast-travel system; Worshippers' Woods is the entry-grace representative and other activated destinations remain profile-level dynamic options.

record.mode: Siofra River → Nokron, Eternal City（本地数据声明桥接）
record.note: 由本地游戏数据可达性声明补全的桥接边；方向按本地声明推断，未做玩家步行验证。

record.label: Astel defeated
record.hint: The route beyond the Astel arena is only available after the boss encounter is complete.

record.label: Baleful Shadow defeated
record.hint: Conservative route state for the Ranni progression before the descent from Nokstella Waterfall Basin to Lake of Rot.

record.label: Cursemark of Death available
record.hint: The Ranni/Carian Study Hall progression has produced the Cursemark required for Fia's Deathbed Dream.

record.label: Deep Siofra Well lift unlocked
record.hint: Two Stonesword Keys have been used at the northern Siofra lift; the elevator between Below the Well and Caelid is usable.

record.label: Dragonkin Soldier of Nokstella defeated
record.hint: The southern Ainsel optional boss has been cleared and its post-boss grace is available.

record.label: Fia's Champions defeated
record.hint: The Deeproot Champions arena has been cleared and the Prince of Death's Throne grace is available.

record.label: Lichdragon Fortissax defeated
record.hint: Fia's Deathbed Dream dragon encounter has been cleared.

record.label: Mimic Tear defeated
record.hint: The Nokron city boss gate has been cleared and the Ancestral Woods route is open.

record.label: Mohg, Lord of Blood defeated
record.hint: The Cocoon of the Empyrean post-boss grace is kept closed before Mohg is defeated.

record.label: Northern Hallowhorn six braziers lit
record.hint: All six braziers around Nokron's northern Hallowhorn Grounds have been lit, enabling the Regal Ancestor Spirit encounter.

record.label: Regal Ancestor Spirit defeated
record.hint: The optional Hollowhorn Grounds encounter has been cleared and its post-boss return state is available.

record.label: Siofra River eight braziers lit
record.hint: All eight braziers around the lower Siofra Hallowhorn Grounds have been lit, enabling the Ancestor Spirit encounter.

record.label: Ancestor Spirit defeated
record.hint: The optional lower Siofra Ancestor Spirit encounter has been cleared and its post-boss return state is available.

record.label: Siofra Dragonkin Soldier defeated
record.hint: The optional Dragonkin Soldier reached through the upper Siofra sending gate has been cleared.

record.label: Valiant Gargoyles defeated
record.hint: The Deeproot coffin route is kept closed until the Siofra Aqueduct boss gate has been cleared.
